claims.content: If the Customer attempts to retract a confirmed bid, the system rejects the attempt because auction bids may not be cancelled; the retraction is not performed and the confirmed bid remains in effect.

If a bid retraction is not possible because the auction has ended or the bid was already superseded by a higher bid, the system displays an error message to the Customer indicating that the bid cannot be retracted.
The system prevents bid retraction if the user is currently the highest bidder on an item.

claims.content: The Customer wants to cancel a bid during an auction.
The Customer has a confirmed bid on an item in an auction that is currently active (the auction has not yet ended).
The Customer attempts to cancel a bid during an auction.
If the Customer attempts to retract a confirmed bid, the system rejects the attempt because auction bids may not be cancelled; the retraction is not performed and the confirmed bid remains in effect.

If a bid retraction is not possible because the auction has ended or the bid was already superseded by a higher bid, the system displays an error message to the Customer indicating that the bid cannot be retracted.
The system prevents bid retraction if the user is currently the highest bidder on an item.
The confirmed bid is cancelled and removed from effect.
The retracted bid is removed from the item's current bidding history.
If the retracted bid was the displayed high bid, the displayed high bidder is updated to reflect the next highest valid bid.
